overview_description.description: Revolut is a financial services company that specializes in mobile banking, card payments, money remittance, and foreign exchange. Revolut started as a platform for providing prepaid debit cards and currency exchange but has since expanded its services to include cryptocurrency trading, stock trading, insurance, and various other financial products. It operates in numerous countries worldwide and is known for its mobile app, which allows users to manage their finances, make payments, and track spending.

about_short_description.short_description: Revolut is a financial technology company that offers banking services, money transfers, foreign exchange, and spending analytics.

product.name: Revolut Personal Account
product.description: A digital banking account for managing income, payments, spending, balances, and everyday finances through the Revolut app.

product.name: International Money Transfers
product.description: A service for sending and receiving money internationally through bank transfers, card transfers, mobile wallets, payment links, and Revolut accounts.

product.name: Currency Exchange and Multi-Currency Accounts
product.description: A service for holding, exchanging, and spending in multiple currencies through Revolut accounts, with in-app rates, limits, and fees.

product.name: Revolut Cards
product.description: Physical, virtual, and disposable virtual debit cards for online, contactless, in-store, and mobile-wallet payments.

product.name: Revolut Business
product.description: A business banking platform offering multi-currency accounts, global payments, cards, expense controls, accounting integrations, and business financial management.

product.name: Business Payment Acceptance
product.description: Merchant payment tools for accepting online, in-person, and mobile payments through Revolut Pay, payment links, invoices, terminals, and payment gateways.
